prompt: Objective: decide whether a gym should add a cheaper off-peak membership. What you've learned: peak hours are full while mornings and afternoons are 30% used. Latest finding: a survey shows 25% of non-members would join at a lower off-peak price. What is the best next step?

options.text: Ask the interviewer what discount the gym has in mind
options.feedback: Drive the case: work out the trade-off yourself.

options.text: Measure peak-hour usage day by day
options.feedback: Already answered: peak hours are full.

options.text: Calculate revenue if the off-peak plan were half price
options.feedback: That ignores current members who might downgrade.

options.text: Weigh the gain from new off-peak members against downgrades
options.feedback: Right. Demand exists; the open question is whether downgrades by current members eat the gain.

explanation: 25% of non-members would join off-peak. Weigh their revenue against current members downgrading.
